data_models=read_rds("./records data/record_data_for_glmms.rds") %>% 
  mutate(time_series_id=paste(h3_id,species))

```{r}
# Prepare the basin-wide annual signal
# Prepare the basin-wide annual signal
annual_signal <- data_models %>%
  filter(first_rec_year >= 1987) %>% 
  group_by(year_of_records) %>%
  summarise(
    basin_median_sst = mean(median_sst, na.rm = TRUE),
    basin_mean_mhw_ci = mean(annual_c_int, na.rm = TRUE),
    new_events = sum(records, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(cum_colonization = cumsum(new_events))

# --- Dynamic Scaling Factors ---
max_col <- max(annual_signal$cum_colonization, na.rm = TRUE)
max_mhw <- max(annual_signal$basin_mean_mhw_ci, na.rm = TRUE)

# Scale factor for MHW bars
scale_mhw <- max_col / max_mhw 

# Scale factor for SST
min_sst_basin <- min(annual_signal$basin_median_sst, na.rm = TRUE)
max_sst_basin <- max(annual_signal$basin_median_sst, na.rm = TRUE)
scale_sst <- max_col / (max_sst_basin - min_sst_basin) * 0.2 

p_general <- ggplot(annual_signal, aes(x = year_of_records)) +
  # A. Cumulative Expansion (Green Area)
  geom_area(aes(y = cum_colonization), fill = "seagreen", alpha = 0.4) +
  
  # B. MHW Pulses (Orange Bars)
  geom_col(aes(y = basin_mean_mhw_ci * scale_mhw), 
           fill = "orange", alpha = 0.5, width = 0.8) +
  
  # C. Labels for MHW Intensity
  geom_text(aes(y = basin_mean_mhw_ci * scale_mhw, 
                label = round(basin_mean_mhw_ci, 1)), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "darkorange4", check_overlap = TRUE) +
  
  # D1. Observed Annual SST (The Jagged Line) - ADDED THIS
  geom_line(aes(y = (basin_median_sst - min_sst_basin) * scale_sst * 5),
            color = "darkred", alpha = 0.5, size = 0.8) +

  # D2. Chronic Warming Trend (The Smooth Dashed Line)
  # geom_smooth(aes(y = (basin_median_sst - min_sst_basin) * scale_sst * 5), 
  #             method = "lm", color = "darkred", size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed", se = FALSE) +
  
  # Axes and Labels
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Cumulative Colonization (Momentum)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / (scale_sst * 5) + min_sst_basin, 
                        name = "Basin-wide annual SST (°C)")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Synthesis: The Chronic Warming 'Conveyor Belt'",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "darkred"),
        axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "darkred"))
p_general

ggsave("./plots/General_Synthesis_Plot.png", plot = p_general, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

Species level
```{r}
# Filter for frequent colonizers (>= 10 hexagons)
frequent_colonizers <- data_models %>%
  filter(records == 1,
         first_rec_year>=1987) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  filter(sum(records)>=3) %>% 
  distinct(species) %>% 
  pull(species)

# Create output directory structure
dir.create("./plots", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("./plots/Species_Plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

for (sp in frequent_colonizers) {
  
  # 2a. Prepare Species Data
  sp_data <- data_models %>%
    filter(species == sp) %>%
    group_by(year_of_records) %>%
    summarise(
      annual_basin_sst = median(median_sst, na.rm = TRUE),
      annual_mhw_int = mean(annual_c_int, na.rm = TRUE),
      new_colonizations = sum(records, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(year_of_records) %>%
    mutate(cum_colonizations = cumsum(new_colonizations))
  
  # 2b. Find Threshold Year (3rd record)
  threshold_row <- sp_data %>% filter(cum_colonizations >= 3) %>% slice(1)
  threshold_year <- if(nrow(threshold_row) > 0) threshold_row$year_of_records else max(sp_data$year_of_records)
  
  # 2c. Dynamic Scaling
  max_sp_col <- max(sp_data$cum_colonizations, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_sp_mhw <- max(sp_data$annual_mhw_int, na.rm = TRUE)
  scale_sp_mhw <- if(max_sp_mhw > 0) max_sp_col / max_sp_mhw else 1
  
  min_sp_sst <- min(sp_data$annual_basin_sst, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_sp_sst <- max(sp_data$annual_basin_sst, na.rm = TRUE)
  scale_sp_sst <- max_sp_col / (max_sp_sst - min_sp_sst)

  # 2d. Plot
  p_sp <- ggplot(sp_data, aes(x = year_of_records)) +
    
    # MHW Bars
    geom_col(aes(y = annual_mhw_int * scale_sp_mhw), 
             fill = "orange", alpha = 0.3) +
    
    # MHW Labels (Added)
    # Only show labels where intensity > 0
    geom_text(data = filter(sp_data, annual_mhw_int > 0),
              aes(y = annual_mhw_int * scale_sp_mhw, 
                  label = round(annual_mhw_int, 1)), 
              vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "darkorange4", check_overlap = TRUE) +
    
    # Post-Establishment Area (Blue - Background)
    geom_area(aes(y = cum_colonizations), fill = "#3182bd", alpha = 0.6) +
    
    # Pre-Establishment Area (Green - Overlay)
    geom_area(data = subset(sp_data, year_of_records <= threshold_year),
              aes(y = cum_colonizations), fill = "seagreen", alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # Observed SST Line (Solid Red)
    geom_line(aes(y = (annual_basin_sst - min_sp_sst) * scale_sp_sst), 
              color = "darkred", 
              size = 1, 
              linetype = "solid") +
    
    # Axes (Secondary Axis for SST)
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Cumulative Colonizations",
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_sp_sst + min_sp_sst, 
                          name = "Annual SST (°C)")
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=3,linetype="dashed",alpha=0.4)+
    # Labels (Removed Subtitle)
    labs(
      title = paste(sp),
      x = "Year"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "darkred"), 
      axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "darkred")
    )
  
  # 2e. Save
  filename <- paste0("./plots/Species_Plots/", gsub(" ", "_", sp), ".png")
  ggsave(filename, plot = p_sp, width = 8, height = 6, bg = "white", dpi = 300)
  
  message(paste("Saved:", sp))
}
```
